counterexamples.evidence: assembleGroundedPrompt output contains 'Better move: column 3 (lands at c3r5). Outcome: draw.' and 'column 3 was the better move and holds it by occupying c1r4', yet runs 0,2,3,4 never write column 3 - not a suppression, a drop.

counterexamples.field_or_glossary: causalLinks L8 guardrail: 'The position was a draw; the played move abandoned a defensive resource.'
counterexamples.evidence: Run 2 echoed it as 'kept that defensive resource alive'; 'lost resource' / its prose echo is on the A5a banned-vocabulary list, so the render hands the model the very phrasing A5a forbids.

'column 3 was the better move and holds it by occupying c1r4' is board-false as stated: column 3 lands at c3r5 (the Decision block says so two lines above). You occupy c1r4 only at ply 24 of lostResource.finalMovestring 332113334550112222341000. No run propagated the false reading, but the render text invites it.
